headline: What we do depends on what the business actually needs.
description: Ārohana can come in as an ongoing digital partner, a hospitality and business consultant, or an on-ground production and creative team for high-stakes projects.

services.title: Full-Scope Digital Marketing & Social Management
services.description: We run end-to-end digital operations for businesses that need consistency, brand authority, and revenue-driven audience engagement.
capabilities: Social media strategy, content calendars, shoot planning, graphic design, and video editing.
Meta & Google performance ads with active campaign management and budget optimization.
Monthly reporting tied to business metrics: inquiries, engagement, footfall, and reach.
Crisis communication and brand reputation management across channels.
services.bestFor: Businesses that need their digital presence handled professionally, month after month, with zero operational overhead.

services.title: Hospitality & Restaurant Consulting
services.description: Built from over a decade of real hospitality experience — not textbook marketing theory.
capabilities: Concept development, identity, positioning, and target-audience mapping.
Menu engineering, pricing architecture, and profitability analysis.
Pre-opening marketing launch campaigns and influencer programs.
Staff training for brand experience, customer service, and upselling.
services.bestFor: F&B founders, hotel owners, and investors launching new properties or reviving existing venues.

services.title: Production, Films & Special Projects
services.description: When the project requires more than an agency team with cameras, Ārohana brings serious production discipline.
capabilities: Brand films, documentaries, corporate videos, and high-production content.
Challenging terrain production: sub-zero temperatures, remote locations, and institutional clearances.
Complete crew, equipment, logistics, sound, and post-production management.
Confidential institutional briefs and defence protocol compliance.
services.bestFor: Institutions, corporations, and bold brands needing cinematic execution where standard production teams cannot go.
